{{External|rs}} {{HasTask|Spiders}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Giant crypt spider |image = [[File:Giant crypt spider.png|250px]] |release = [[9 May]] [[2005]] |update = Barrows |members = Yes |combat = 79 |size = 1 |examine = Not very incey wincey. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 8 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 50 |slayxp = 80 |cat = Spiders |assignedby = turael,spria |hitpoints = 80 |att = 65 |str = 67 |def = 65 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 20 |dslash = 20 |dcrush = 10 |dmagic = 17 |dlight = 20 |dstandard = 20 |dheavy = 20 |elementalweaknesstype = Fire |elementalweaknesspercent = 40 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id = 1684 }} '''Giant crypt spiders''' are a stronger variant of [[giant spider]] found in the tunnels of the [[Barrows]]. Giant crypt spiders are one of the many obstacles between a player and the chest containing rewards where they constantly distract players from completing puzzles. As with all monsters in the crypts, they are [[aggressiveness|aggressive]] to any player regardless of their [[Combat level]].
